title: The Chained Angel
text: Something with burned wings is chained to the shrine's altar with iron links as thick as a wrist. Its feathers have fallen around it like ash, and the stone beneath it is scorched in the shape of its body. It is still alive. It watches you come, and it asks for nothing.

options.label: The most devout breaks its chains, believing nothing holy should be bound like a beast.

outcomes.text: The chains break. It follows you home on its ruined wings, and no one knows what it will become.
The chains break, and it is gone in a burst of light. Something else, very far off, has noticed what you did.

options.label: End it, while it still asks for nothing and before it can ask for something.

outcomes.text: It does not fight. What is left of it is ash, and the ash is holy, and nobody can meet the others' eyes.

options.label: Leave it chained, and leave quickly. Someone bound it here for a reason.

outcomes.text: It watches you go. It does not ask then, either, and somehow that is the hardest part.
